findings.summary: Brain launch kill switches are not in the durable feature-flag contract.
findings.details: S13-T03 requires default risky external surfaces to remain off until launch enablement and lists the existing feature flag policy seam as an owned file. The implementation adds Brain launch flag literals/defaults in ops code, but the durable FeatureFlagKey schema still rejects those keys and defaultFeatureFlagPolicies never includes them, so list/evaluate/upsert cannot expose or persist the semantic/external delivery launch gates.
evidence: packages/convex/confect/ops/flags.spec.ts:39-50 upsertPolicyInternal accepts only FeatureFlagKey from the table schema, not BrainOperationLaunchFlagKey.
packages/convex/confect/ops/flags.impl.ts:15-26 defines brainOperationLaunchFlagDefaults but packages/convex/confect/ops/flags.impl.ts:28-67 does not include them in defaultFeatureFlagPolicies.
packages/convex/test/flags.test.ts contains no Brain launch flag expectation, and ci-proof-packet.json changedFiles omits that planned test file.
